title: Photos not appearing normally when opened in app
author: nt179
text: Photos taken on iPhone 16, as well as other devices, appear normally in grid but become washed out and over-exposed appearing after tapping the photo to view. Seems like people think this is an issue with HDR data, but this has not been resolved to date. Considering changing photo storage apps entirely.

title: Deleted APP

text: Downloaded it then immediately deleted it because every photo had a thing called “categories” at the top of every photo that I did not want and found impossible to remove. I found it annoying and distracting. Never going back. It was also constantly asking me to back up photos (which I did not want to do) and distracting me with memories, moments and other dumb things for the short attention spanned. 👎👎👎
